name: CLI Cognitive Health Report
statement: A developer or agent diagnoses knowledge quality by running health-cognitive, receiving a structured report covering freshness distribution, conflict counts, confidence statistics, knowledge gaps, and stale domains, with optional threshold configuration.
successCriteria: limen health-cognitive returns JSON CognitiveHealthReport with all 6 sections: totalClaims, freshness, conflicts, confidence, gaps, staleDomains
freshness section contains fresh, aging, stale counts and percentFresh
conflicts section contains unresolved count and critical array with claimIds and subject
confidence section contains mean, median, below30, above90
gaps array entries have domain, lastClaimAge, significance
staleDomains array entries have predicate, newestClaimAge, claimCount
Empty database returns all-zero report with empty arrays
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: health-cognitive --gapThresholdDays 'abc' crashes instead of returning JSON error
health-cognitive --staleThresholdDays -5 crashes instead of returning JSON error
Report missing any of the 6 required sections
Freshness distribution does not sum to totalClaims
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
